title: Visual screenshots now included in Google Meet meeting notes
facebook: Ever wish you could see exactly what everyone was looking at during a meeting? Soon your meeting notes will include screenshots of any slides or screens shared — so you'll have the visual context too, not just words. https://aiworldhq.com/article/google-meet-s-ai-notes-will-soon-show-screenshots-of-shared-slides #GoogleMeet #Productivity
